name: FUME HOOD
desc: Premium 1500mm Industrial Fume Hood with integrated Wet Scrubber System. Engineered for safe extraction and neutralization of toxic chemical vapors, featuring a 20mm chemical-resistant Polypropylene worktop and a high-speed exhaust assembly generating ≥1000 cfm suction.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS FUME HOOD integrates a 1500 mm chemical-resistant polypropylene work zone with a high-velocity exhaust assembly and cylindrical wet scrubber to provide ISO 9001-aligned and ASTM E84/ISO 14175-compliant containment for toxic vapors. Doctors and clinical laboratory personnel rely on this hood for safe handling of formalin, xylene, and histology stains during tissue processing and slide preparation, while B.Sc/M.Sc students and PhD researchers use it for acid digestion with HCl, HNO3, HF, and perchloric acid, as well as for handling VOCs such as acetone, chloroform, benzene, and methanol in organic synthesis and analytical sample preparation. The integrated spray tower scrubber with PP Pall rings and mist eliminator neutralizes acidic and alkaline fumes before exhaust, protecting both the operator and the laboratory environment from corrosive vapors and micro-aerosols during chemical and biological assays.
sop: Ensure the fume hood is connected to a three-phase 220V/440V supply and the wet scrubber water tank is filled to the indicated level.
Switch ON the main isolator and then turn ON the exhaust motor and water recirculation pump; confirm the LED chamber light is functional.
Press the 'SET' button once on the PID controller to enter the setpoint mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter such as exhaust airflow setpoint or scrubber recirculation interval.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and allow the controller to maintain the configured extraction and scrubbing condition.
Slide the vertical toughened glass sash to the recommended safe working height typically 200 to 300 mm and allow the hood to purge for at least 5 minutes before introducing chemicals.
Place chemical containers, acid digestion vessels, or staining reagents at least 150 mm inside the worktop and avoid blocking the rear baffle slots.
After work, close the sash, run the exhaust and scrubber for an additional 10 minutes to clear residual vapors, then switch OFF the motor and pump.

Safety Warning: Never handle perchloric acid, hydrofluoric acid, or highly volatile solvents with the sash fully open or without verifying the exhaust suction is at least 1000 cfm and the wet scrubber recirculation is active; incompatible chemicals must not be mixed inside the hood.
